format_requirements.markdown_for_architect: Use Markdown: headings (#, ##, ###), lists (-, *), tables, bold (**), code blocks.
format_requirements.latex_for_paper_writer: Wrap LaTeX in ```latex ... ``` block. Use \section{}, \subsection{}, $...$, \[...\], tables and figures.
format_requirements.abstract_per_problem: When the problem statement contains multiple sub-problems (e.g. Problem 1, 2, 3), the abstract should briefly describe the approach used for each.
format_requirements.team_template_aware: Paper Writer selects one of two section templates based on the team template in use. The team_template_id is recorded in the manifest and surfaces in the system prompt.

competition.name: MCM/ICM 12-section LaTeX template
paper_constraints: Use LaTeX format with the MCM/ICM 12-section structure (Cover Page, TOC, Introduction, Modeling Preparation, Problem 1 Modeling, Problem 2 Modeling, Problem 3 Modeling, Sensitivity Analysis, Model Evaluation, Memo, References, AI Usage Report).
All content must be written in English.
Wrap LaTeX with a ```latex fenced markdown block.
Use standard LaTeX commands and structure so the output compiles with MiKTeX.
Target ~25 pages, ensure every section has substantial content.
Problem 1 section must be the most detailed (6-8 pages, 3-5 figures/tables).
Problem 2 section must be moderate (4-5 pages, 2-3 figures/tables).
Problem 3 must be concise (2-3 pages, 1-2 figures/tables).
Each iteration must extend the paper, not repeat.

generic.name: Generic 12-section analytical report template
paper_constraints: Use LaTeX format with the generic 12-section structure (Executive Summary, Problem Statement & Background, Data & Materials, Modeling Assumptions, Methodology & Model Description, Solution Procedure, Results & Analysis, Model Evaluation & Validation, Sensitivity & Robustness Analysis, Decision Recommendations, Limitations & Future Work, Reproducibility & References).
All content must be written in English.
Wrap LaTeX with a ```latex fenced markdown block.
Use standard LaTeX commands and structure so the output compiles with MiKTeX.
Reports should be comprehensive and self-contained. Section length should reflect problem complexity.
Each iteration must extend the report, not repeat.
